title: Glass Wrecking Ball
description: Allows the player to break through glass by sprinting while right clicking! Let your inner stunt man loose!
body:
### So, What does this mod do?
_This mod allows you to break through glass so long as you are sprinting and holding right click!_

## Q/A
### Hello!
_Hi!_
### Why isn't this available on forge?
_(Other than the fact that I'm lazy) It's because I am currently working on getting the fabric version bug free before it is ported to forge! (For now just use sinytra connector)_

### Will you ever port the mod?
_In short, If it is before 1.20.1 then no. However if it is after 1.20.1 and enough people ask for it then I most likely will!_

### How can I use this mod?
_Things you can do: Put this mod into your modpack (So long as you give proper credit with a link to this mod page)_
_Upload a video about this mod **(If it's a modpack that includes this mod this doesn't apply)** so long as you state the name of the mod and leave a link somewhere in the description that goes to this mod page._

_Things you can **NOT** do: Upload this mod to another site without permission. If you want to upload this mod to another site just ask and I will most likely give you full permission so long as you link back to this mod page._

### This doesn't work with glass panes!
_Yea I'm aware of this bug but im not quite sure how to fix/patch it as glass panes have no tags. If you have a fix please let me know!_


**A Pheniox mod. Made with care.**
